title: It’s AMAZING but…
body: I love Onrise it is a completely free app and as soon as you download it you don’t need to sign in or buy any monthly subscriptions it has a clean format which I absolutely love but the one thing about it is that you can create premade habits but you cannot create your own in your own words, Onrise please fix that! Back to the positive it has no ads
author: bcandylock

title: Amazing!
body: This is the perfect app! Perfect interface is visually appealing and easy to navigate. It doesn’t have any unnecessary features that clutter up the place, and best of all it doesn’t have any ads and is completely free. I will never use anything else. Thank you guys for this! Amazing job!
